assertions.name: lower_bound_below_pdg_comparator
assertions.source: Sanity: the no-removal lower bound sits below the PDG comparator, consistent with E_EM > 0.

description: EXPLORATORY stage-1 scoping of the operational m_d - m_u extraction (sm-params-quark-masses, bean qou-m3vl): delta_QCD = Delta_pn + E_EM. Finding: the framework derives Delta_pn, but its only derived EM mechanism (tanh(ln q0) x strong bond) is inter-nucleon; the intra-nucleon EM self-energy is the SAME open two-like-charge EM-linking invariant that owns the 3He mirror residual. One invariant blocks both. Lattice/PDG numbers are comparators, not inputs; no fit.

comparators_external.note: delta_QCD ~ beta*(m_d - m_u) with beta ~ O(1) scheme-dependent; magnitudes agree at the ~2x level under the external comparator, as expected for a scheme quantity — no precision claim is made.

data.honest_gap: The extraction is well-posed but blocked on ONE corpus object: the intra-nucleon EM self-energy (two-like-charge EM-linking invariant). That is the same open invariant as the remaining 69% of the 3He mirror split (a3-mirror-residual-reconciliation). Deriving it closes both this extraction and the A=3 mirror residual simultaneously. Until then the framework-scheme delta_QCD is bounded below by Delta_pn and no m_d - m_u value is claimed.
